workshop_message_precondition.source: Pantheon BFF commit ab3377dcad634ee88ce5ad28c54f657098cda67a strategy-workshop router: GET emits W/"workshop:{id}:vN" as ETag and meta.etag; message mutations reject a missing precondition with 428 and a stale value with 409.
workshop_message_precondition.frontend_behavior: Immediately before each Workshop message POST, StrategyWorkshopPage fresh-reads the canonical Workshop, requires its non-empty BFF-issued meta.etag, and passes the exact value through the client headers option so the generic numeric-lock quoting helper cannot rewrite it. The 202 body is treated only as an event receipt (event_id, sequence_no); StrategyWorkshopPage polls only the canonical GET /events projection with 250/500/1000/2000/4000ms bounded backoff and an 8-second deadline, requiring the receipt event_id before reconstruction. It verifies the Workshop identity before and after each readback, so navigation/unmount cannot trigger reconstruction for the prior Workshop.
workshop_message_precondition.hosted_assertion: The strict-live Playwright journey captures the fresh GET and message POST, requires the POST If-Match header to byte-match that GET response ETag, then observes each canonical GET /events response until it contains the 202 event_id. It records event_id, readback_attempts, and its 12-second proof deadline in the hosted artifact, fails if reconstruction is requested before the accepting readback, requires non-empty data.reconstruction_id from the reconstruction result, and records durable Strategy and Registry identities only from the following canonical versions readback.
workshop_message_precondition.failure_behavior: A missing ETag, absent event receipt, a receipt absent at the finite readback deadline, or a Workshop change stops before reconstruction and Persona writes; a server 409 stays visible and no fallback, duplicate message pipeline, or follow-on write is attempted.
